The seven former per-part configs (8091-8097) each served a single part
folder as the web root. That stopped working when the shared fonts and the
character stills moved to unit-assets/ at the repo root: css/style.css now
resolves ../../unit-assets/fonts/*.ttf, which escapes a part-rooted server
and 404s. A part-rooted server is fundamentally incompatible with shared
assets, so the per-part entries are gone rather than left to fail quietly.
